notes: Canonical construct is physical running ability from first running step to about 90ft; initial acceleration, top speed and speed maintenance must remain visible and no single component may replace the whole construct.
2026 NPB+ top speed is the current direct top-speed lane only.
H2F, 90ft and acceleration evidence must be surfaced separately with context and confidence where available.
30m, 50m and similar measurements remain profile/prior evidence even when a direct conversion is invalid.
Historical physical evidence must preserve date, injury and temporal-distance context and require an explicit carryover reason.
Statistical proxy evidence remains separate context and is not weighted by next-year repeatability.
Mixed game signals such as infield-hit, GIDP avoidance, triples and advance/UBR must be explicitly represented or scoped, not silently lost.
Physical-observation community evidence must be distinct from game-rating and technique context.
Pure physical speed must stay separate from stealing and baserunning technique.
PowerPro is review/stale context only and not the player-level physical teacher.
A source or field provenance failure is scoped to that source or field and cannot erase the broader construct lane.
Every player row must represent each required lane as evidence or explicit bounded missingness with confidence and provenance.
